04/ 15.05.2024:
Nobody appeared on behalf of the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the State is present.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with C.P. Case No. 1240 of 2021,
registered under sections 323, 341, 498A of the I.P.C. and under section 4 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Bokaro.
3.
It is averred in the petition that the petitioner is husband of the complainant and there is general and omnibus allegation against all the accused persons.
Further is averred that annexure-2 series are documents wherein it is stated that the allegation of lost of eye sight of the complainant was occurred prior to marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer on the ground that the petitioner is husband and there are allegations of assault.
5. Looking to Solemn Affirmation it appears that there are general and omnibus allegation against all the accused persons whereas the petitioner who happened to be husband.
Annexure-2 series are documents which suggest that the allegation of lost of eye sight of the complainant was occurred prior to marriage,.
6. In the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class,
Bokaro, in connection with C.P. Case No. 1240 of 2021, subject to conditions as laid down under Ghatu Kaibartta vs The State Of Jharkhand & Another ..... ...
